integrity: The fixed-site first-passage formula and nearest-neighbor special case are explicitly credited to prior literature. New claims are the quenched population classification, boundary-integrability optimum, and sharp farthest-site rare-mixture law. Numerical examples are not used as infinite-domain proofs. Literature priority is subject to unindexed and unavailable earlier work.
limitations: Strictly one-dimensional continuous-time nearest-neighbor symmetric lattice motion; each sampled initial/reset site is frozen for the whole search; no conclusions for resampled reset locations, finite intervals or higher-dimensional walks.
title: Quenched-distance lattice resetting: unique optimal rates, an integrability edge, and a rare-tail exponent
